title: Environment Creature-Discovery Contract & GM Preset Projection
purpose: Define a deterministic read-only projection by which a composed ENV environment can expose source-supported creature candidates to an authorized GM while preserving CEW ecology/distribution authority, World/Reality/Setting/Place authority, Campaign/GM visibility authority, provenance, unresolved facts and ENV-HS-1.0 ecological-fit semantics.

environment_context.rule: The environment input is already resolved through ENV composition and overlay semantics before creature discovery projection.

candidate_creature.rule: ENV-16 consumes these facts; it does not author or normalize them into new canonical creature truth.

authority_context.rule: The projection never expands visibility beyond the permissions supplied by the controlling campaign/GM authority.

facet_semantics.native_common: Requires source-supported native/resident distribution plus common frequency or an equivalently explicit ordinary-occurrence assertion. Ecological fit alone never creates this facet.
facet_semantics.possible_tolerated: A GM-facing possibility facet for source-supported presence/allowance with compatible, preferred or conditional ecological fit where no stronger occurrence facet is established. It never means native or common.
facet_semantics.migratory_seasonal: Requires source-supported migration, season or time-window authority. Current-scope activity is evaluated separately from baseline distribution.
facet_semantics.introduced_invasive: Requires source-supported introduced, invasive or domesticated distribution state; environmental similarity cannot infer introduction history.
facet_semantics.rare_exceptional: Requires source-supported rare, exceptional, unique/named or comparable frequency/occurrence authority. No percentage or random-encounter rate is inferred.
facet_semantics.overlay_enabled: Requires an explicit CEW/source creature interaction with an active ENV overlay/context. Overlay presence alone does not invent creature affinity.
facet_semantics.canonical_presence_conflict: Preserves a source-backed canonical presence assertion when ecological-fit or local-condition evidence conflicts or remains unresolved. The projection surfaces the conflict rather than deleting the canonical occurrence or pretending the ecology matches.
facet_semantics.excluded_or_blocked: Used when an explicit controlling distribution, ecological, overlay, temporal or visibility gate blocks current discovery. Exclusion retains reasons/provenance for authorized GM diagnostics.
facet_semantics.unresolved: Used when material authority is unknown, not established or contradictory. Unresolved candidates cannot be promoted to native/common/present claims.

identity_and_authority_gate.rule: Only governed creature identities/candidates enter discovery; ENV-16 creates no duplicate creature catalog.

campaign_visibility_gate.rule: Discovery never leaks player-hidden or campaign-suppressed information through environment selection.

canonical_distribution_gate.rule: World/Reality/Setting/Place and CEW distribution authority can veto mere ecological suitability. Habitat fit cannot manufacture range.

ecological_fit_gate.canonical_presence_conflict_rule: When controlling source authority explicitly places a creature in the current range but ecological fit is incompatible or indeterminate, keep the creature discoverable_with_warning under canonical_presence_conflict and preserve both authorities for CEW/source repair.

overlay_condition_gate.rule: Active overlays may satisfy an already-authored creature predicate; they never create creature affinity, adaptation, ability, summon, bond or distribution authority.

season_activity_gate.rule: Season/activity changes current occurrence projection without rewriting canonical range.

precedence_and_conflict_rules: explicit distribution absence blocks habitat-derived presence unless a separate authoritative local/campaign placement overrides it
explicit canonical presence is preserved even when ecological-fit evidence conflicts; the conflict is shown, not silently resolved
explicit current-scope overlay or temporal exclusion can suppress current occurrence without erasing baseline distribution
no hidden score, last-write-wins rule or source-order tie breaker may convert contradictory authority into certainty

gm_result_contract.stable_grouping_rule: Group by explicit facets/outcome and stable creature identity; do not sort by an invented ecological/discovery score.
gm_result_contract.selection_is_not_acquisition: Selecting an environment or seeing a candidate does not create ownership, taming, bond, familiar, mount, NPC, encounter or placement state.

query_modes.normal_discovery: Return discoverable/conditional candidates and their reasons under current authoritative context.
query_modes.include_blocked: Authorized GM diagnostic view may also return excluded_or_blocked candidates with blocking reasons and provenance.
query_modes.include_unresolved: Authorized GM diagnostic view may also return unresolved candidates so source/CEW gaps are visible rather than guessed.
query_modes.candidate_universe_rule: The candidate universe comes from governed creature/CEW/distribution indexes or explicit caller-provided candidates; ENV-16 does not require a new duplicate all-creatures database.

env16_requires_cew_to_later_supply: personhood/NPC and partnership facets where source-supported

non_authorities: no distribution inference from habitat similarity
no rarity/frequency percentages or encounter rates
no ability/adaptation grant from environment or overlay
